name: skfolio-pdk-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is skfolio, a Python library for portfolio optimization and risk
management built on top of scikit-learn.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the portfolio-evaluation and data-preparation subsystem of skfolio: every module under src/skfolio/portfolio/, src/skfolio/population/, src/skfolio/measures/, src/skfolio/metrics/, src/skfolio/preprocessing/, src/skfolio/pre_selection/ and src/skfolio/utils/, and the modules src/skfolio/__init__.py, src/skfolio/_constants.py, src/skfolio/exceptions.py, src/skfolio/typing.py, src/skfolio/prior/__init__.py, src/skfolio/prior/_base.py and src/skfolio/prior/_empirical.py, together with the user-guide pages docs/user_guide/portfolio.rst, docs/user_guide/population.rst, docs/user_guide/data_preparation.rst, docs/user_guide/cross_sectional_transformers.rst and docs/user_guide/pre_selection.rst, the example-gallery files examples/data_preparation/README.txt and examples/data_preparation/plot_1_investment_horizon.py, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
